reached_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim AS d2 ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN customer AS c2 ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
        WHERE d2.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
        AND c2.c_last_name = customer.c_last_name
        AND c2.c_first_name = customer.c_first_name
        AND d2.d_date = date_dim.d_date
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim AS d3 ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN customer AS c3 ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c3.c_customer_sk
        WHERE d3.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
        AND c3.c_last_name = customer.c_last_name
        AND c3.c_first_name = customer.c_first_name
        AND d3.d_date = date_dim.d_date
    )
) hot_cust LIMIT 100
